sources.title: Kernel Samepage Merging
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: EDAC：以暴露時間正規化可更正錯誤
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付內容去重帳本、映射總需求、80/120 GiB 餘裕表與不適用於檔案快取的說明；請同學只使用交付件重算兩組，保留失敗案例與限制；全程使用合成檔案，不對生產系統執行故障。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver the deduplicated-content ledger, total mapping demand, 80/120 GiB reserve table and the boundary excluding file-cache sharing. The fixture performs no host KSM configuration changes. Have a peer reproduce both configurations from the artifacts, retaining failed cases and limitations. Use synthetic files throughout; never inject these faults into a production system.
related.difference: 每事件列 module_id、timestamp、severity、counter_epoch；每模組另列有效觀測區間，不能以單一牆鐘跨度替代暴露量。
related.differenceEn: Record module_id, timestamp, severity and counter_epoch for each event. Keep per-module valid observation intervals separately, rather than using one wall-clock span for modules with missing telemetry.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 若一份大小 B 的內容由 r 個映射完整共享，全部分離的額外容量為 (r-1)B；忽略頁表、碎片及不完全相同內容；共享內容為 40 GiB；名義有三個映射，變更四個；每份在解除合併後都完整獨立；名義式 (3-1)*40 = 80 GiB additional；變更式 (4-1)*40 = 120 GiB additional。所有數值、限制與門檻為原創合成教學條件；來源支援概念與介面，不代表實機量測或設備規格。

聚合率為有效觀測期內 CE 總數除以各模組觀測小時總和；排除停機期間並保持事件層級一致；十六個模組連續觀測 24 小時，名義 32 個 CE、變更 64 個；假設無重置且報告已去重；名義式 32/(16*24) = 0.0833333333333 CE/module-hour；變更式 64/(16*24) = 0.166666666667 CE/module-hour。所有數值、限制與門檻為原創合成教學條件；來源支援概念與介面，不代表實機量測或設備規格。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: If r complete mappings share one identical B-sized backing set, fully separating them requires an additional (r-1)B. The model excludes page tables, fragmentation and partially identical content. Use a 40 GiB identical backing set shared by three mappings, then four. Every mapping becomes fully independent after unmerging; the assumption is deliberately stronger than a workload with only a few modified pages. Nominal (3-1)*40 = 80 GiB additional; changed (4-1)*40 = 120 GiB additional. Every numeric input, limit and threshold is an original synthetic teaching condition. References establish concepts and interfaces, not measured machine results or equipment specifications.

Aggregate rate is corrected-error count divided by summed observed module-hours. Exclude unobserved downtime and keep the event hierarchy consistent, avoiding double-counting controller and module reports. Observe sixteen modules continuously for twenty-four hours. The nominal fixture contains 32 corrected errors and the changed fixture 64, with no counter reset and already deduplicated events. Nominal 32/(16*24) = 0.0833333333333 CE/module-hour; changed 64/(16*24) = 0.166666666667 CE/module-hour. Every numeric input, limit and threshold is an original synthetic teaching condition. References establish concepts and interfaces, not measured machine results or equipment specifications.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: HPC 封包化：payload 粒度與線上位元組
related.titleEn: HPC packetization: payload granularity and wire-byte accounting
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付內容去重帳本、映射總需求、80/120 GiB 餘裕表與不適用於檔案快取的說明；請同學只使用交付件重算兩組，保留失敗案例與限制；全程使用合成檔案，不對生產系統執行故障。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver the deduplicated-content ledger, total mapping demand, 80/120 GiB reserve table and the boundary excluding file-cache sharing. The fixture performs no host KSM configuration changes. Have a peer reproduce both configurations from the artifacts, retaining failed cases and limitations. Use synthetic files throughout; never inject these faults into a production system.
related.difference: 產生 packet_id、payload_bytes、overhead_bytes 表；每包 payload 不超上限，合計必須還原原始訊息。
related.differenceEn: Generate a table of packet identifiers, payload bytes and overhead bytes. Enforce the per-packet payload limit and reconcile all payload fragments to the exact original message length.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 若一份大小 B 的內容由 r 個映射完整共享，全部分離的額外容量為 (r-1)B；忽略頁表、碎片及不完全相同內容；共享內容為 40 GiB；名義有三個映射，變更四個；每份在解除合併後都完整獨立；名義式 (3-1)*40 = 80 GiB additional；變更式 (4-1)*40 = 120 GiB additional。所有數值、限制與門檻為原創合成教學條件；來源支援概念與介面，不代表實機量測或設備規格。

封包數為 ceil(message_bytes/payload_limit)，總線上量為訊息量加封包數乘 overhead；最後一包可不滿載；訊息 1048576 B，每包額外 64 B；payload 上限由 4096 改為 1024 B，無重傳與填補；名義式 1048576+ceil(1048576/4096)*64 = 1064960 modeled wire B；變更式 1048576+ceil(1048576/1024)*64 = 1114112 modeled wire B。所有數值、限制與門檻為原創合成教學條件；來源支援概念與介面，不代表實機量測或設備規格。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: If r complete mappings share one identical B-sized backing set, fully separating them requires an additional (r-1)B. The model excludes page tables, fragmentation and partially identical content. Use a 40 GiB identical backing set shared by three mappings, then four. Every mapping becomes fully independent after unmerging; the assumption is deliberately stronger than a workload with only a few modified pages. Nominal (3-1)*40 = 80 GiB additional; changed (4-1)*40 = 120 GiB additional. Every numeric input, limit and threshold is an original synthetic teaching condition. References establish concepts and interfaces, not measured machine results or equipment specifications.

Packet count is the ceiling of message bytes divided by payload limit. Modeled wire bytes equal message bytes plus packet count times fixed overhead; the final packet may carry less payload. Send a 1048576-byte message with a synthetic 64-byte overhead per packet. Payload limit changes from 4096 to 1024 bytes, excluding retransmissions, padding and other unmodeled link framing. Nominal 1048576+ceil(1048576/4096)*64 = 1064960 modeled wire B; changed 1048576+ceil(1048576/1024)*64 = 1114112 modeled wire B. Every numeric input, limit and threshold is an original synthetic teaching condition. References establish concepts and interfaces, not measured machine results or equipment specifications.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
